title: Accessible Routes — Accessibility and Universal Design
body:
Accessible Routes. This record belongs to the Accessibility and Universal Design database and covers accessible routes in full working detail: what it is, when it applies, how it is set out, and how it is checked. The database as a whole covers accessible routes, clearances, usability, inclusive design, checklists and jurisdiction requirements.

Actual content. Accessible Routes is executed as follows. First, confirm the building type, the project stage and the governing requirements for the jurisdiction, and record those decisions before any dimension or quantity is fixed. Second, lay out the work from the controlling dimensions, keeping clearances, tolerances and interfaces with adjoining work explicit rather than assumed. A complete accessible routes entry therefore carries its dimensions, its materials, its sequence, its tolerances and its check results, not a title alone.
